national_news.title: Defence Acquisition Council Approves Capital Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, approved capital acquisition proposals worth approximately ₹2.12 lakh crore for the Indian Armed Forces.
In line with self-reliance in defense, nearly 82% of the total procurement proposals will be sourced directly from the Indian industry.
Major approvals include High Mobility Vehicles (HMV), Long Range Kamikaze Drone Systems, Light Multi Role Helicopters (LMRH), and Active Offboard Decoy Systems for the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Extends RELIEF Scheme for Exporters Facing Logistics Disruptions
bullets: The Department of Commerce under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry extended Component II of the Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation (RELIEF) scheme.
Under Component II, exporters receive 95% risk coverage through the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC) to counter geopolitical disruptions in West Asia and the Gulf region.
The scheme covers Full Container Load, Less than Container Load, and refrigerated containers (excluding energy shipments) to protect exporters against freight escalation and war-related risks.

national_news.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Held in New Delhi
bullets: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla addressed the inaugural session of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum hosted in New Delhi.
The forum was held under the theme 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development', highlighting peaceful solutions to global economic instability, regional conflicts, and climate change.
Attended by PM Narendra Modi and Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh, the event brought together parliamentary delegations from 11 BRICS member nations and 10 partner countries.

national_news.title: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva Wins Fourth Term as President of Brazil
bullets: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential runoff election, securing 51% of the total vote to defeat Flavio Bolsonaro.
This marks an unprecedented fourth non-consecutive presidential term for Lula, making him the only politician in modern Brazilian history to achieve this milestone.
At 80 years of age, Lula becomes the oldest president to be sworn into office since Brazil restored its democracy.

national_news.title: ISRO to Operate Four Launch Pads by 2029 to Boost Space Infrastructure
bullets: ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan announced that India will expand its space launch capabilities to four functional launch pads by 2029.
The expansion includes a 2,000-acre Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) complex at Kulasekarapattinam in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, alongside a third launch pad at Sriharikota.
ISRO highlighted upcoming milestones, including uncrewed Gaganyaan test flights and Chandrayaan-5, a collaborative lunar mission with Japan's JAXA featuring a 350-kg rover.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Addresses Chinmaya Mission Event, Highlights '4F' Crisis in Global South
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar addressed an event marking the 75th anniversary of the Chinmaya Mission in New Delhi.
Highlighted that the Global South is currently facing a '4F' crisis comprising finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser challenges.
Reiterated zero tolerance for terrorism as an instrument of statecraft and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates RBI's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) new Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Emphasized the critical role of modern computing infrastructure and specialized cybersecurity capabilities in protecting India's expanding financial system from cyber threats.
Highlighted key financial inclusion milestones, including nearly 60 crore Jan Dhan accounts and 13 crore first-time entrepreneurs supported under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana.

national_news.title: GeM Promotes 'The AABHAR Collection' Storefront to Support Artisans and ODOP Products
bullets: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) launched 'The AABHAR Collection', a dedicated digital storefront featuring One District, One Product (ODOP) and Geographical Indication (GI) tagged items.
Features 294 product catalog listings from 10 State and Central Handloom and Handicraft Emporiums including Khadi India, Himcrafts, Jharcraft, and Cauvery.
Provides direct market linkage for artisans, weavers, and women-led enterprises to supply official gift hampers for public sector procurement.

national_news.title: Ministry of Health Observes Vigilance Awareness Week 2026
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 from October 26 to November 1, 2026, featuring an Integrity Pledge-taking ceremony at Kartavya Bhawan, New Delhi.
The observance coincides with the birth anniversary week of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel (October 31).
The theme for the 2026 campaign is 'Probity for Prosperity', focusing on transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in public administration.

national_news.title: SEBI Outlines Next Growth Phase and Regulatory Reforms for Capital Markets
bullets: Addressing the 16th ANMI International Capital Market Convention, SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey noted that India's equity market capitalization has reached ₹470 lakh crore, with Mutual Fund AUM at ₹83 lakh crore.
SEBI's investor education campaign 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' achieved over 15 crore social media views and sent nearly 110 crore messages to curb reliance on unregistered financial influencers.
Regulatory updates under development include reviewing short selling and securities lending/borrowing frameworks, boosting corporate bond secondary trading, and introducing an AI sandbox.

national_news.title: CRPF Disarms and Takes Over Kuki Militant Group's Sinai Camp in Manipur
bullets: Security forces led by the CRPF's CoBRA battalion disarmed and took control of the Sinai Camp in Manipur's Kangpokpi district, which was previously a designated camp for KNA and KLA under the Suspension of Operation (SoO) agreement.
The joint security operation was conducted following an ambush near the facility that resulted in the death of three civilians.
During the inspection, security teams identified 17 unauthorized individuals operating under false identities inside the SoO-designated camp.

national_news.title: India Calls for Diplomacy, Economic De-risking, and Human-Centric AI at Chinmaya Sammelan
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar addressed the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi, emphasizing dialogue and diplomacy as the key solutions to ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and West Asia.
Highlighted the severe '4F crisis' (Finance, Fuel, Food, and Fertilizer) impacting the Global South, calling on the Global North to help de-risk and diversify international markets.
Advocated for a responsible, inclusive, and human-centric approach to Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ensure it remains democratized rather than controlled by a few.

national_news.title: India Slams Pakistan at UN Committee Over Minority Rights and 'Form 47' Administration
bullets: India's First Secretary to the UN, Raghoo Puri, exercised the right of reply during the UN General Assembly's Third Committee dialogue on minority issues.
Described Pakistan's government as a 'Form 47 administration' controlled by its military, highlighting the severe decline and oppression of minority communities in Pakistan.
Reaffirmed that the entire Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India and called on Pakistan to vacate illegally occupied territories.

national_news.title: PM Highlights 'Vocal for Local' Exports, Organic Farming, and River Restoration
bullets: Highlighted global demand for Indian local products under 'Vocal for Local', including Makhana exports from Purnia (Bihar) to Greece and Shabari Naturals tribal products winning Japan's Good Design Award.
Commended the 'Nav-Trinjan' initiative by Punjab's Kheti Virasat Mission for promoting naturally colored organic cotton cultivation and establishing weaving schools.
Praised community-led ecological restoration in Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, which successfully recharged groundwater and revitalized the Heval river.

national_news.title: Centre Achieves Target of Creating 11 Crore Farmer IDs Five Months Ahead of Deadline
bullets: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare created 11 crore unique Farmer IDs under the Digital Agriculture Mission, five months ahead of the March 2027 target.
The Digital Agriculture Mission was approved by the Union Cabinet on September 2, 2024, to build Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for the agriculture sector.
Over 6 crore farmers have directly received scheme benefits through the verified Farmer ID delivery system, reducing fraud and redundant verification paperwork.

national_news.title: India Achieves Historic Best Performance with Record 114 Medals at Asian Para Games 2026
bullets: India's para-athlete contingent concluded the Asian Para Games 2026 with a historic best-ever total of 114 medals.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded the contingent for their exceptional determination and record-breaking performance at the Games.
The achievement represents India's highest medal tally in the history of the Asian Para Games.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Scheme Boosts Youth Entrepreneurship in Sheikhpura, Bihar
bullets: Sanjeet Barnwal, a resident of Sheikhpura, established a successful mushroom production business supported by the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme.
The business supplies packaged mushrooms to Sheikhpura, neighbouring districts like Lakhisarai, Nawada, and Jamui, and markets in West Bengal.
The initiative has enabled him to achieve financial independence and create livelihood opportunities for approximately 12 local people.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally and 1st in Asia
bullets: The Bihar Museum in Patna secured the 9th rank among the world's 100 best museums and the 1st rank in Asia in 2026.
Developed with the involvement of Lord Cultural Resources (a Canadian consultancy), its foundation stone was laid in June 2013 and it was fully dedicated to the public in 2017.
The museum houses historical artefacts, ancient coins, manuscripts, and folk art, and an underground tunnel of 1.5 km is planned to connect it with the historic Patna Museum.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Flags Off First Direct Flight from Gaya to Bangkok
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister virtually flagged off IndiGo's first non-stop international flight from Gayaji (Gaya) to Bangkok, Thailand.
The new direct air route aims to boost tourism, cultural exchange, and economic activities, particularly benefiting the Magadh region and Buddhist pilgrims visiting Bodh Gaya.
The initiative strengthens international air connectivity and supports local businesses including hotels, transport operators, and handicraft enterprises.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Partners with IT Companies to Train Government School Teachers in AI
bullets: Bihar’s Education Department partnered with 11 IT firms, including Google Education, to provide training in artificial intelligence and digital technologies to government school teachers.
Centralised training will be conducted at the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) campus with arrangements expected to be in place by January.
The state also plans to make computer education compulsory from Class 6 in government schools and introduce smart classrooms across 700 model schools.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Allows Ayurvedic Lecturers' Appeals Against Termination in Bihar
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed appeals by Ayurvedic lecturers against the termination of their services under the Bihar Private Medical (Indian System of Medicine) College (Taking over) Act, 1985.
The Court ruled that eligibility for absorption should be assessed based on the cutoff date of June 1, 1986, rather than the initial appointment date.
The judgment quashed previous High Court rulings and ordered the reinstatement of appellants with consequential benefits including pensions.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Education Department Issues Deadline for Science Laboratory Construction in Schools
bullets: Bihar education authorities issued show-cause notices to RailTel and Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd (TCIL) over delays in constructing science laboratories in government schools.
Out of 2,199 targeted schools under the Samagra Shiksha scheme, laboratories were completed in only 351 schools, prompting a strict deadline of November 30.
RailTel and TCIL are responsible for executing the turnkey projects across assigned districts, which include supplying physics, chemistry, and biology laboratory equipment and furniture.
